title: Swatara Township approves $120.3M community benefits agreement with Corscale Data Centers for two proposed campuses

summary: Swatara Township commissioners voted 4-1 to approve a community benefits agreement with Corscale Data Centers worth $120.3 million, directed mainly to township capital funds, public safety facilities and equipment, and workforce items. Residents had asked for a delay because they had not seen the agreement beforehand.

title: Aurora City Council removes data centers as a permitted use in the mixed-use office institutional zone
summary: The Aurora City Council unanimously adopted a zoning change that no longer allows data centers as a permitted use in the mixed-use office institutional zone district. Per the article, data centers remain permitted by right in other districts and conditionally allowed in two mixed-use districts.
source_title: Colorado Politics — Aurora City Council bans data centers in mixed-use office zones
verbatim: The Aurora City Council unanimously passed a new regulation on data centers Monday night | will no longer allow data centers as a permitted use in the mixed-use office institutional zone district
notes: Headline says 'bans' but the action is a zoning-district change (permitted use removed in one district), not a citywide ban; wording must stay as 'removes permitted use'.
